purpose: Strict single-seed pilot for PathMNIST and BloodMNIST
assumptions: This pilot consumes only the already generated k=50 global selection indices for PathMNIST and BloodMNIST.
The single downstream training seed is 42; Random and FPS therefore consume their seed42 subsets.
Training reads validation only, saves best_val_checkpoint.pt, then evaluates test exactly once.
This pilot output is separate from both old test-best results and the full 400-run Table 1 output.
